outboundMessages.description: Notify QAC website on all the Workorder related to agency service request created or updated in Salesforce including the once which is coming from the website itself.
outboundMessages.name: QAC Workorder Notification

rules.description: Send outbound messages to QCP queue whenver a Work order record relevant to agency related service request is created or updated
rules.formula: AND( Case.RecordType.Name = "Service Request", RecordType.Name = "Service Request", ISPICKVAL(Case.Account.Type, "Agency Account"), NOT(ISBLANK(Case.Account.Qantas_Industry_Centre_ID__c)), NOT( OR( ISPICKVAL(Case.Type, "Group Waivers"),ISPICKVAL(Case.Type, "SBT"),ISPICKVAL(Case.Type, "Service Request"), ISPICKVAL(Case.Type, "Commerical Waiver (non BART)"), CONTAINS( TEXT(Case.Problem_Type__c) , "Internal") ) ) )
